sum-cookies-1: We use cookies and similar storage for essentials such as sign-in and security, for remembering choices like theme and language, for analytics and performance, and for advertising.
sum-cookies-2: Ad cookies come from Google AdSense, only after you answer the cookie notice. They are never set for paid members, and never on sign-in, settings, wallet, checkout or messages pages.
sum-cookies-3: You can change your choice any time under Settings, Privacy and data, and through your browser. Blocking essential cookies will break parts of the site.
sum-cookies-4: Preference and analytics cookies typically expire within 12 months.
sum-disclaimer: This is a summary, not the legal text. The full policy below is what applies.
sum-privacy-1: We collect what you give us (name, email, account details), how you use the site (pages, features, device identifiers) and technical data (IP address, browser, operating system, screen size).
sum-privacy-2: We use it to run and improve the site, handle early-access requests, keep things secure, meet legal duties, and send product updates only if you opted in.
sum-privacy-3: We do not sell your personal data. We share it with service providers who help run the site, with authorities when the law requires it, and in a merger or sale.
sum-privacy-4: Depending on where you live you can ask to access, correct, delete, restrict or move your data, or object to some uses. Write to privacy@rmhstudios.com.
sum-privacy-5: The site is not for people under 18, and your data may be processed in other countries.
